mods.description: Control Baritone with natural language commands via a local LLM (Ollama)

releases.notes:
Alpha 1.0.0 marks the first public release of AI Baritone Commander, a client-side Fabric mod that enables natural-language control of Baritone using a local LLM (Ollama).

This alpha release focuses on establishing a reliable and extensible core architecture, prioritizing correctness, performance, and determinism over feature breadth.

Key features

Natural-language commands mapped to structured, validated action plans

Fast deterministic routing for common commands (no LLM required)

Two-stage AI planning (fast parse + deeper planning when needed)

Optional Baritone integration with graceful fallback

Fully client-side, offline-capable, and private by design

This release is intended for early adopters, developers, and contributors. APIs, behavior, and features may change as the project matures.
